Kaito Ishikawa (Japanese: 石川界人 Ishikawa Kaito) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Ishikawa was born October 13, 1994 in , and became a voice actor as an adult. Ishikawa's best known roles in the were during , during which he voiced , one of , and Officer Jenny's Gumshoos. Ishikawa is currently affiliated with .
